philosophy: Fusion over Imitation: Mix disparate disciplines.
Emotion First: Design for feeling, not just function.
Content is King: Every page tells a story.
Contrast: Use light vs. dark, rough vs. smooth.
anti_patterns: Purple/Teal for CTA (Use Fresh Green/Organic Orange instead)
Inter everywhere (Use Playfair Display for headings)

primary.name: Fresh Basil
primary.usage: Primary Buttons, Active States, Success Icons

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary-hover shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-text-primary border border-border hover:bg-background-subtle hover:border-primary transition-all duration-300 font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2
buttons.ghost: text-text-secondary hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 transition-all duration-200 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg

inputs.default: bg-white border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 transition-all duration-200 outline-none w-full text-text-primary placeholder:text-text-muted

cards.recipe: group bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-border/50 hover:border-primary/30 hover:shadow-hover transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col h-full
cards.meal_plan: bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-border hover:border-primary/50 transition-all cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden

navigation.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full w-64 bg-white border-r border-border p-6 flex flex-col gap-2 z-50 hidden md:flex
navigation.mobile_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-border p-4 flex justify-around items-center z-50 md:hidden backdrop-blur-lg bg-white/90

layout_strategies.dashboard: Bento Grid: Summary stats (top), Current Meal Plan (middle), Featured/Recent Recipes (bottom). Use asymmetry.
layout_strategies.recipe_detail: Two-column Layout (Desktop): Left = Ingredients (Sticky), Right = Instructions & Story. Hero Image spans full width at top.
layout_strategies.meal_planner: Calendar Grid: 7 Columns (Days) x 3 Rows (Meals). Drag & Drop enabled visual cues.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px, depending on size. Consistent rounded caps.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-to-background ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring using 'ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Avoid custom CSS classes unless for complex animations.
Install 'lucide-react' for icons if not present.
Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions and micro-interactions.
Keep components modular. Create a 'components/ui' folder for reusable atoms (Button, Input, Card).
Ensure the app is fully responsive (Mobile First approach).
Use the provided image URLs. Do NOT use placeholders.
Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Dashboard.
Use 'Playfair Display' for all Headings (H1-H3) to give it that 'Food Magazine' feel.
Use 'Inter' for body text for maximum readability.
Primary Action Buttons (Save, Add to Plan) should be 'Fresh Basil' Green.
Secondary Actions (Cancel, Back) should be outline or ghost styles.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'SaaS' look. Make it feel organic and tactile.
No gradients on text. Keep it legible.
Use ample whitespace. Food needs room to breathe.
Shadows should be soft and colored (e.g., green-tinted shadow for green buttons).
Never use pure black (#000000). Use Dark Charcoal (#111827).
Interactive elements must have clear hover and active states.
